gloss: ruby text; furigana; reading aid above kanji

definitions.gloss: ruby text; furigana; reading annotations placed above or beside kanji
definitions.explanation: Small characters placed above (in horizontal text) or beside (in vertical text) kanji to indicate their pronunciation. Named after the typographic term 'ruby' for small-sized type.

examples.english: To add ruby text to kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供向|こどもむ}け→子供向け：17933_kodomomuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ルビ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。

⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ルビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Adding ruby text to difficult kanji is helpful for readers.

notes:
From the English typographic term 'ruby,' which refers to a small type size (5.5 points). In Japanese publishing and web design, ルビ refers to the small reading annotations placed alongside kanji characters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ルビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to add ruby/furigana text
- ルビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to attach ruby text
- ルビ⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with ruby text
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ルビ: full ruby (every kanji annotated)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{仮名|がな}→振り仮名：12792_furigana⟧ (furigana): furigana — the native Japanese term for the same concept; more commonly used in everyday language
- {読|よ}み{仮名|がな}: reading kana — another term for pronunciation guides

USAGE:
ルビ is the preferred term in publishing, typography, and web development (HTML has a `<ruby>` tag). ⟦{振|ふ}り{仮名|がな}→振り仮名：12792_furigana⟧ is more common in educational contexts and everyday conversation. Both refer to the same thing.
